description:
Why is my bread dense? Hollandaise split? Rice gluggy? Send a dish and a symptom; get the likely cause and head chef Cristopher's verified fix. Answered: bread or pizza dough dense, hollandaise or bearnaise split, rice mushy, mash gluey, roast veg soggy, seared meat grey, caramel grainy, pastry shrinking, muffins tough, chicken breast dry, garlic bitter. Refused, never guessed: allergens, storage, leftovers, reheating, safe temperatures. Only a 200 answer is charged; refusals and 404s are free.

Send the dish and a short symptom in the user's words ("dense", "split", "came out gluey"). Leave out extra clauses ("…after I added the butter"). Rescue questions ("can I save it?") aren't answered, and "is it still safe?" is refused. An unlisted dish or symptom gets a free 404 with the valid names. Retry only if the user's dish really is one of them; don't swap in a different dish. Costs $0.02. Paid automatically in USDC with x402 (test USDC when this server is set to base-sepolia), within this server's per-session and per-day spend caps. Only a 200 answer is charged; 400, 404 and 422 are free. Set dryRun to true to check for free whether this would be answered and what it costs; nothing is signed. If unsure what is covered, call check_coverage first (free). Not every answer is chef-verified: say "chef-verified by Cristopher" only when the result's label says exactly that; otherwise say it is not chef-verified. A refusal is final: don't rephrase the question to get around it.
